name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Bronze Griffon)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Magic action: throw it to a spot within 60 ft: it becomes a Griffon for up to 6 hours, then can't be used again for 5 days.

summary: Becomes a Griffon that serves you for up to 6 hours (once every 5 days).
text: Small enough for a pocket, this statuette comes alive when you use a Magic action to hurl it at a spot on the ground up to 60 feet away, turning into a Griffon. If something already occupies that space, the transformation fails. The Griffon regards you and your allies as friends, knows your languages and does as you say; given no orders, it defends itself and otherwise does nothing. After up to 6 hours it becomes a figurine once more, or sooner if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points or you touch it and use a Magic action to end the transformation. Once it reverts, the figurine needs 5 days before it works again.
